The test message text is `"alpha beta gamma https://x.y/z omega"` with entities for bold over `"alpha beta gamma"`, nested italic `"beta"`, nested code `"gamma"`, and a URL entity over `"https://x.y/z"`. In `_parse_html`, the bold entity is handled first and recursively becomes `"alpha beta gamma"`. The function concatenates the bold insert, the escaped space before the URL, the URL insert, and the trailing `" omega"`, yielding the final `html_text`. ## Answer {"escaped_text":"https://x.y/z","html_text":"alpha beta gamma https://x.y/z omega","insert":"https://x.y/z"}
